extensions.org.licoland.adapter.pi/purpose: The Pi adapter: the Pi RPC driver vocabulary and the vendor protocol that classifies one `pi --mode rpc` JSONL line exactly once below the adapter port. The kernel owns no part of Pi and depends on none of it.
extensions.org.licoland.adapter.pi/persistentDataRe: This package declares no conversion because it owns no persisted package data of its own: it writes no data home, no cache and no store. The Pi session records it reads belong to the installed Pi client, and the client's own conversation store remains the kernel's.
